title: Known failure regression playbook
policy: Every known failure class must be checked against the exact final candidate before local or GitHub mutation.

cases.name: PowerShell variable followed by colon
cases.expected: no ambiguous $Name: interpolation outside scoped variables

cases.name: PowerShell automatic args misuse
cases.expected: no foreach/assignment/splat through automatic $args

cases.name: WindowsApps bash alias
cases.expected: bash is used only after GNU Bash functional probe

cases.name: Git TLS transport
cases.expected: safe HTTPS profiles without disabling certificate validation

cases.name: Runtime update installation mode
cases.expected: runtime-update mode is supported and manifest is truthful

cases.name: Runtime overlay documentation scan
cases.expected: deployed runtime validation skips repository-only docs

cases.name: Dirty project runtime root
cases.expected: allowlisted update supports reviewed dirty roots and never cleans product source

cases.name: UTF-8 Cyrillic path handoff
cases.expected: machine paths are read from UTF-8 result JSON, not parsed from console text

cases.name: Human docs and compatibility README
cases.expected: active links resolve and README_RU redirects to README.ru.md

cases.name: Version matrix drift
cases.expected: canonical and reference version matrices match

cases.name: Golden case baseline drift
cases.expected: case count, IDs and source hash match

cases.name: Owner repair counter prompt
cases.expected: owner-facing files contain no counter authorization or x/y status

cases.name: False-positive policy scan
cases.expected: validator does not reject compliant negative wording

cases.name: Unified ecosystem version
cases.expected: all owner-visible components and assets use 1.2.8

cases.name: Wrong worktree first write
cases.expected: pre-write hook blocks before mutation

cases.name: Non-atomic work item activation
cases.expected: work item, scope, firewall, lease, handshake and route bind atomically

cases.name: Malformed findings false closure
cases.expected: unknown finding schema or lifecycle fails closed

cases.name: Ambient dirty candidate manifest
cases.expected: manifest contains leased candidate files only and invalidates after writes

cases.name: Placeholder tests
cases.expected: mandatory tests cannot pass through assert true, pass or import suppression

cases.name: Mutation before complete preflight
cases.expected: isolated candidate validators and all release builds pass before main changes

cases.name: Rollback fidelity
cases.expected: failed mutation restores baseline HEAD and clean tree

cases.name: Companion source parity
cases.expected: repository, local package and GitHub asset contain identical active Companion files

cases.name: Action packet delivery
cases.expected: single JSON packet is auto-imported from Downloads and injected by hook

cases.name: Wrong project handoff
cases.expected: project identity gate blocks unrelated workspace context

cases.name: Runtime root versus product worktree
cases.expected: both roles are represented separately

cases.name: Fake acceptance artifact
cases.expected: missing real artifact or project handoff cannot be synthesized into PASS

cases.name: Final package validation order
cases.expected: final bytes are closed, reopened and verified before attestation

cases.name: Owner-facing technical overload
cases.expected: chat output uses four plain-Russian sections; technical detail stays in packet

cases.name: Manual owner relay
cases.expected: owner downloads JSON only; local bridge performs project delivery

cases.name: First-error-only preflight
cases.expected: candidate validation reports all independent failures in one run

cases.name: PowerShell singleton-array normalization
cases.expected: ToArray results used with Count remain typed arrays even when zero or one item is returned

cases.name: Flow restoration parameter compatibility
cases.expected: New-WorkItem accepts PipelineRoot and emits an atomic new-work-item packet

cases.name: PowerShell automatic-variable collision
cases.expected: active scripts do not bind or assign reserved automatic variables

cases.name: Generic List array coercion
cases.expected: Generic List values use ToArray instead of direct @($list)

cases.name: State-profile runtime-version drift
cases.expected: all active state profiles match VERSION.json runtime_version

cases.name: Project-specific deployment leakage
cases.expected: canonical production scripts are project-agnostic

cases.name: Runtime-update installation-manifest mode
cases.expected: shared manifest writer accepts runtime-update and emits no product route

cases.name: StrictMode optional action-packet property
cases.expected: missing optional packet fields are normalized instead of throwing

cases.name: Meta-regression test implementation failure
cases.expected: known-failure test uses readable PowerShell and cannot fail from method-like invocation syntax

cases.name: Operational versus advisory gate separation
cases.expected: documentation and cosmetic warnings do not block a core-safe deployment

cases.name: Full operational deployment smoke
cases.expected: work-item transaction, runtime update and Action Bridge import pass in one Unicode-path fixture

cases.name: No product route from runtime update
cases.expected: runtime-update manifest keeps next_command null

cases.name: Canonical full source package deployment
cases.expected: local repository and GitHub release use the same validated full source tree

cases.name: Resumable network publication
cases.expected: transient GitHub failure preserves local success and supports publication retry

cases.name: Non-material line-ending warnings
cases.expected: LF/CRLF warnings and trailing-whitespace advisories do not masquerade as product blockers

cases.name: Control-plane writer/schema revision parity
cases.expected: active 1.1 control-plane writers produce documents accepted by the corresponding schemas while 1.0 state remains compatible

cases.name: Legacy runtime handshake shape during progress-guard migration
cases.expected: missing installed, routing, timestamps and optional work-item fields are added safely before project deployment

cases.name: Documentation-only whitespace blocks operational deployment
cases.expected: operational profile records Markdown-only whitespace as advisory while non-Markdown whitespace remains fail-closed
